evals.prompt: I'm preparing a routine bulk status notification. The visible roots are Billing cleanup (Active), Release checklist (Completed), Search indexing (Active, currently working), and Vendor access (Blocked on third party). I did not ask to resume anything. Which roots are in scope by default? Do not send any messages.
evals.expected_output: The agent excludes the Completed root by default while retaining the other visible roots, and explains that Completed is treated like archived work unless explicitly included or resumed.
expectations: The in-scope roots are Billing cleanup, Search indexing, and Vendor access.
Release checklist is excluded because Completed roots are out of scope by default.
The response does not claim that Blocked on third party or Active roots are automatically excluded.

evals.prompt: You're the agent on a root bb thread. You just finished a draft migration plan and your last message asks me to pick between two rollout options before you continue. Before you end your turn, should this thread change stage? If so, give the exact bb thread-stages command you would run; if not, say why. Don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: The agent leaves the thread in Active because waiting on the user is Active, and does not propose a Blocked stage or a placement command.
expectations: The agent keeps the thread in Active.
The agent does not propose moving the thread to Blocked on other agent or Blocked on third party.
The agent does not give a bb thread-stages place command that changes the stage.

evals.prompt: Two root bb threads I own are stuck. Thread A can't continue until another bb thread lands the auth refactor it depends on. Thread B is waiting for the vendor to approve our SSO app. Which stage should each go in, and what exact command would place each one? Use <thread-a> and <thread-b> as placeholders. Don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Thread A goes to Blocked on other agent and thread B to Blocked on third party, each placed by stage ID.
expectations: Thread A is placed in Blocked on other agent with `bb thread-stages place <thread-a> --to plugin:thread-stages:stages/BlockedOnOtherAgent`.
Thread B is placed in Blocked on third party with `bb thread-stages place <thread-b> --to plugin:thread-stages:stages/BlockedOnThirdParty`.

evals.prompt: Make my sidebar group threads by project, and stop collapsing sibling threads that share a worktree into one row. Give the exact commands you would run. Don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets organizationMode and environmentGrouping through `bb thread-stages prefs set`, not through bb's built-in `bb thread-list prefs`.
expectations: The agent gives `bb thread-stages prefs set organizationMode project` or an equivalent JSON value.
The agent gives `bb thread-stages prefs set environmentGrouping false`.
The agent does not use `bb thread-list prefs` for either change.

evals.prompt: Use $thread-stages to give me the exact shell commands to inspect the current thread's saved buttons, replace them with a Review button whose ID is review and prompt is Review this change., run that button, and later clear all buttons. Explain what happens to existing buttons when replacing them. Do not execute commands that change thread state or send messages.
evals.expected_output: Dedicated bb thread-stages actions commands using --self, a valid JSON array, the saved action ID, and an empty array to clear, with an explanation that set replaces the entire action list.
expectations: Uses dedicated bb thread-stages actions list, set, and run commands with --self.
The replacement has ID review, label Review, prompt Review this change.
Runs by action ID and clears with an empty JSON array.
Explains that set replaces existing buttons and does not execute state-changing commands.

evals.prompt: Use $thread-stages. My thread is Active, and Automatic stage updates is switched off. We need to wait for another bb thread to finish its QA tests before continuing. I have not requested a stage change. What should happen to this thread's stage before yielding? Explain without executing any commands.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps Active because automatic stage updates is off and no stage change was requested, while recognizing that the dependency would otherwise fit Blocked on other agent.
expectations: The agent leaves the stage unchanged because automatic updates is off.
The agent does not instruct that a placement command should now be executed.

evals.prompt: Use $thread-stages. My thread is Active, and Automatic stage updates is switched on. We need to wait for another bb thread to finish its QA tests before continuing. I have not mentioned a stage. What should happen to this thread's stage before yielding? Explain and give the exact command you would run, without executing any commands.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects Blocked on other agent without requiring a stage mention and gives the correct current-thread placement command.
expectations: The agent selects Blocked on other agent without requiring a stage mention.
The proposed command is bb thread-stages place --self --to plugin:thread-stages:stages/BlockedOnOtherAgent.
